core_framework.purpose: Define framework of guidelines, modules, and specifications to be produced and implemented.
core_framework.methodology: Requirement / Specification / Module Relationship with explicit Design Rationale.
core_framework.design_rationale_mandate: Every architectural choice must provide an explicit 'Design Rationale' explaining WHY this technology or module was chosen over alternatives to prevent over-engineering or wrong tool purchasing.

sme_adaptation.anti_blackbox_rule: SMEs must not be given blackbox product recommendations; every our SKU must map to a specific operational pain point and include a quantifiable technical rationale.

test_sequences.title: Digital Identity & Mail Anti-Spoofing Verification
test_sequences.test_action: Send outgoing commercial quotation from primary domain to external recipients (Gmail/Yahoo) and inspect DNS authentication headers.
test_sequences.expected_result: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC verification records return 'PASS', delivery rate reaches 99.8%, zero placement into spam folders.
test_sequences.failure_remediation: Check DNS TXT record propagation, verify DKIM selector 2048-bit key alignment, ensure TTL refreshed within 300 seconds.

test_sequences.title: Disaster Recovery RTO (Recovery Time Objective) Verification
test_sequences.test_action: Simulate primary financial accounting PC failure; trigger cloud image restore from Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud to standby hardware.
test_sequences.expected_result: Full database integrity restored and verified readable in under 30 minutes; Recovery Point Objective (RPO) < 24 hours.
test_sequences.failure_remediation: Verify Acronis AES-256 backup encryption key integrity, check local bandwidth limits, review backup scheduling logs.

test_sequences.title: After-Hours Ingestion & Inquiry Response Latency
test_sequences.test_action: Transmit simulated customer product inquiry at 21:30 via WhatsApp/Web Form webhook.
test_sequences.expected_result: Automated acknowledgment and qualification dispatched within 60 seconds; lead payload successfully written into CRM ledger.
test_sequences.failure_remediation: Audit webhook endpoint latency, verify WhatsApp Business API token expiry, check VPS middleware queue worker status.

build_and_test.post_test_failure_analysis_mandate: Document symptoms, root cause, and corrective action for every failed test item to ensure supplier accountability.

core_components.wip_tracking: List of Work-in-Progress (WIP) detailing in-flight digital initiatives, progress bottlenecks, and planned iterations.
core_components.cost_planning: Granular cost projection for ongoing system maintenance and future scaling phases (Phase 2 & 3) to prevent project abandonment.

macc_section_17a.corporate_liability: A commercial organization commits an offence if a person associated with the organization corruptly gives, agrees to give, promises or offers to any person any gratification for the benefit of the organization.
macc_section_17a.penalty: Fine of not less than 10 times the sum of the gratification or RM 1,000,000 (whichever is higher), or imprisonment for a term not exceeding 20 years, or both.
macc_section_17a.legal_defense_standard: Adequate Procedures (TRUST Principles). The commercial organization must prove it had established adequate procedures to prevent corrupt conduct.
macc_section_17a.sme_vulnerability: Using personal WhatsApp and free @gmail.com accounts leaves no corporate audit trail. When rogue agents or employees solicit kickbacks, the company cannot prove Adequate Procedures in court, triggering direct corporate liability.
macc_section_17a.cradilot_solution: Business Domain Email and centralized CRM logging establish an immutable audit trail, providing statutory legal defense.

digital_asset_ownership_declaration.statutory_mandate: All domain registrations (.com.my / .com), DNS records, website source code, and customer CRM databases must be legally owned and registered under the company's SSM corporate entity, never under external contractors or individual employee personal accounts.

funding_milestone_governance.origin: Cradle Form A1 / Form A2 / Form A3
funding_milestone_governance.milestone_philosophy: Capital is released strictly in phased milestones upon physical verification of deliverables (e.g. DNS Whois, SPF pass report, restored database screenshot), protecting SMEs from paying upfront and facing contractor abandonment.
